Card Q&A.a: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the left on your side.
Card Q&A.q: What position on the memory gauge does "if you have 1 or more memory" refer to?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon unsuspends.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 1 or more memory, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't suspend until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 of your other Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, this Digimon unsuspends.
